content.text: Please include a PR for the analogous updates required in fcrepo-message-consumer.
A related PR for the message-consumer is here:
, is there any reason not to close this ticket (and the associated PRs) as "Will not Fix"?

The message-consumer will still need a small change (since my proposed indexing# document uses indexing:Indexable rather than indexing:indexable), and the camel component will need some changes to its documentation. Would you like that to be a separate ticket or an extension to this one?
Feel free to change the title of this ticket, and continue to use it.
Re-opening as the consensus was to use an indexing# rather than a config# namespace. The PRs for fcrepo-camel and fcrepo-message-consumer will need to be re-done.
This is addressed with the following PRs:
These PRs anticipate the following change to the fcrepo4/ontology:
and they should not be acted upon until the changes to the ontology are finalized (the PRs may need further refinement).
PRs fcrepo-camel:43 and fcrepo-message-consumer:68 look good... pending ontology:13.
We will need to create a follow-on ticket for updating the wiki documentation.
PRs have been merged into their respective master branches:
The camel component should start using the config# namespace instead of the indexing# namespace. Same thing for fcrepo-message-consumer
